name: The Strat 30-Minute Continuation Shadow
thesis: A completed first-30-minute range break that also clears the prior-day extreme and agrees with full-timeframe continuity may identify a directional 60-minute underlying move without chasing the opening candle.

rules.setup: Use at least four completed daily bars, classify the prior two daily bars as 1, 2U, 2D, or 3, and wait for the regular-session 09:30-09:59 ET opening range to complete.
rules.entry: After 10:00 ET, record a call proxy on the first bar that exceeds both the opening-range high and prior-day high with close above day, week, and month opens; record a put proxy on the symmetric downside condition.
rules.stop: Use the opposite side of the completed 30-minute opening range as the underlying invalidation level.
targets: First favorable prior-week extreme when available
Otherwise leave first-level target unavailable rather than inventing one
rules.exit: Evaluate the underlying counterfactual over a fixed 60-minute horizon and record MFE and MAE; this packet does not claim an option fill or live exit.
rules.sizing: One shadow observation per unique symbol, direction, and trigger timestamp; zero contracts and zero broker notional.
rules.session: Regular session only, opening range 09:30-09:59 ET and trigger window 10:00-15:59 ET.

research.benchmark: directional SPY underlying move over the same 60-minute horizon
research.option_level_promotion_blocker: Point-in-time option quotes and executable fill assumptions are required before any option-return claim.

provenance.original_prompt: Link the existing The Strat 30-minute continuation shadow strategy to the canonical strategy pipeline without duplicating its logic.
